title: A Comparative Evaluation of BERT-Based and LLM-Based Models for Indic Sentence Similarity
abstract: arXiv:2611.19356v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The relative effectiveness of BERT-based encoders and large language model (LLM)-based embeddings for Indic semantic textual similarity remains insufficiently characterized. We compare eight BERT-based and five LLM-based models on the 1,500-pair STS Benchmark development set translated into ten Indic languages and on the native Marathi MahaSTS test set. IndicSBERT achieves the highest Pearson correlation in all ten translated language sets, with a macro-average of 0.843, followed by BGE-M3 at 0.792. Harrier-270M is the strongest LLM-based model on translated STS-B, with a macro-average of 0.751. On MahaSTS, IndicSBERT and Bhasha-Embed-v0 achieve Pearson correlations of 0.901 and 0.900, respectively, while EmbeddingGemma leads the LLM-based models at 0.871. The highest-scoring BERT-based model thus exceeds the highest-scoring LLM-based model in both settings, although the magnitude of the difference varies across benchmarks. These finding

translated_title: 基于BERT与基于大语言模型的印度语系句子相似度模型对比评估
translated_abstract: 基于BERT的编码器与基于大语言模型（LLM）的嵌入在印度语系语义文本相似度任务中的相对有效性仍未得到充分刻画。我们在翻译为十种印度语系的1,500对STS基准开发集以及原生马拉地语MahaSTS测试集上，对八个基于BERT的模型和五个基于LLM的模型进行了比较。IndicSBERT在全部十个翻译语言集上取得了最高的皮尔逊相关系数，宏平均为0.843，其次是BGE-M3的0.792。Harrier-270M是翻译版STS-B上表现最强的基于LLM的模型，宏平均为0.751。在MahaSTS上，IndicSBERT和Bhasha-Embed-v0分别取得了0.901和0.900的皮尔逊相关系数，而EmbeddingGemma以0.871领先基于LLM的模型。因此，得分最高的基于BERT的模型在两种评测设置下均超过了得分最高的基于LLM的模型，尽管差异幅度因基准而异。
tldr: 该研究在十种印度语系翻译的STS基准和马拉地语MahaSTS测试集上系统对比了13个模型，发现基于BERT的模型（如IndicSBERT）在印度语系句子相似度任务上整体优于基于大语言模型的嵌入模型。
en_tdlr: This comparative study of 13 models shows that the best BERT-based model (IndicSBERT) outperforms the strongest LLM-based embedding models for Indic sentence similarity across both translated STS-B benchmarks in ten Indic languages and the native Marathi MahaSTS test set.
